summary: Short kerb on a main road by a junction, with no parking convention.
reasons: Only 26 m long, beside shopping centre

best_section.where: Beatrice Street east kerb, by the shopping centre north of the rail line

drivers.seclusion: Shops and a car park beside it; nearest home 47 m away, but the spot is in full view of the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a main road with traffic lanes right alongside; a couple of cars in Esri but none in QLD.
drivers.traffic: Signalled junction and rail line next to it; busy and noisy.
drivers.convention: No marked parking lane and no consistent parked cars, so a main road with no parking.

flags: Noise from junction and rail line
sun_shade: Open kerb; the large building to the east shades it in the morning.
